verdict.rationale: Draft A offers deeper, better-supported analysis: it explains FY2022 and FY2020 drivers with cited passages, quantifies segment contributions, and ties cash conversion to fuel undercollections. Draft B adds peer ROE and debt issuance but includes unsupported claims (e.g., residential growth unexplained) and misreads FY2023 revenue as a decline. A's grounding and depth are stronger.

Draft A provides deeper causal analysis, better peer context, and more precise red flags with thresholds. It is fully grounded in cited sources and clearly separates analysis from facts. Draft B has some unsupported claims and less interpretive depth.
